diagnosis: Default augmented-Lagrange penetration criterion allows interface compliance much larger than the benchmark displacement accuracy. The converged result is not an acceptable mechanical benchmark.
rationale: Retain default stiffness scaling; require absolute penetration <=1e-7 mm, below 0.02% of the smallest requested platen travel when both interfaces are counted. Negative FTOLN requests an absolute tolerance. Verify actual v241 printed settings and achieved penetration, not just deck syntax.
sensitivity_status: single reasoned correction, not a contact sensitivity study
